assumptions: The antigen is the protein chain with no immunoglobulin variable domain.
limits: Geometry in one deposited model: it is not an energy or a measured contribution to binding.
Alternate conformations and missing atoms limit what can be typed.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the residue-pair contact table, which the outputs carry; the structure tab colours the interface from it and writes no reading over it.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which antibody residues touch which antigen residues in this complex, how close, and what kind of interaction is each?

description: Type the ANTIBODY-ANTIGEN INTERFACE of a deposited complex: which residue of each antibody chain touches which residue of the antigen, how close, and what kind of interaction each pair makes - ionic, polar, weak polar, hydrophobic, aromatic, carbonyl, or a disulfide. The antigen is found rather than named: a protein chain with no immunoglobulin variable domain is the thing being bound. Geometric definitions are CREDO's as Arpeggio implements them, graded contact-for-contact against pdbe-arpeggio. `polar` is the hydrogen-bond criterion WITHOUT the donor angle, because a crystal structure carries no hydrogens; it is the superset an angle test would filter, and no angle-checked hydrogen bond is claimed.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

antibodyChain.description: type only this chain against the antigen. Left out, every chain carrying a variable domain is typed.

antigenChains.description: comma-separated chain ids to treat as the antigen. Left out, every protein chain with no variable domain is the antigen.

interactingCutoff.description: atom pairs further apart than this (Å) are not reported at all; Arpeggio's own default is 5.

model.description: which model of an ensemble to type, 1-based: conformers touch in different places, so one is typed rather than all.

text.description: the coordinate file's contents - a PDB flat file or a PDBx/mmCIF; the format is read from the bytes, not from a name.

name: antibody_antigen_contacts

antibodyChains.description: the chains typed, each with its variable-domain chain types

antigenChains.description: the chain ids treated as the antigen

byType.description: atom pairs carrying each type over the whole interface, distance bands included

contacts.description: one row per residue pair: the antibody residue (chain, author number, name, and its scheme position where it sits in a variable domain), the antigen residue, the closest atom distance, the atom-pair count, and the interaction types

residues.description: how many residues each side contributes, per antibody chain
